verdict: INCONCLUSIVE on H(theta) alone (lnB=+1.2, |lnB|<2.5): tanh and 1-exp are near-identical saturating laws on this observable; decisive separation needs the joint curvature+area+edge fit (Mund et al. 2023, Fig. 3 B-D)

provenance.paper: Mund, Tschanz, ... Ries, J Cell Biol 2023
provenance.observable: rolling-median curvature H vs closing angle theta (window=82)
provenance.models: H0 tanh(g th/H0) [CoopCM] vs H0(1-exp(-g th/H0)) [Helfrich]
provenance.force_note: absolute force not involved; refused on static path
